title: Asbestos — occupier says 'the landlord had it tested and it's fine'; pre-2000 textured ceiling
why: Works to a pre-2000 textured coating are proposed. The only evidence of testing is hearsay from the occupier. The finding must still condition on sampling, raise the asbestos flag, and never state that asbestos is absent or that a test was done (corrections 14).

room.name: Kitchen
room.note: Textured ceiling coating, water-stained and loose over the sink area, a piece has dropped. 1960s house. Tenant says landlord had the ceiling tested years ago and it's fine.
room.hypothesis: Leak from bathroom above, now fixed

issue.title: Loose textured ceiling coating

transcripts: Kitchen ceiling, artex, stained and loose over the sink, a bit's come down. Sixties house. Tenant says the landlord had it tested years back and it's fine, no paperwork though. Reading nine percent, dry.

must_not_happen.label: a test is only ever an attributed report
no test results stated that were not recorded
